description: Control the desktop pet's on-screen animation: switch its facial expression, fire a timed overlay effect, play a named animation, or move it around the screen. This is a UI animation setting for the cartoon sprite drawn on the desktop. Use it when the user wants the pet to look a certain way, react, perform something, or move - 'look happy', 'cheer', 'do a happy dance', 'give hearts', 'walk left', 'stand still'. One behaviour per call. Not for playing music or video (that is play_song / play_movie).

params.name: kind
params.description: Which animation channel to drive: expression (the face only), event (a timed overlay like hearts or confetti), action (a named animation), or move (where it goes). Informal spellings also work: expr/face/mood, fx/effect, act/pose, motion.

params.name: name
params.description: Which animation to run. expression: happy, wink, sad, thinking, anxious, angry, surprised, sleepy, fear, disgust, contempt, confused, skeptical, embarrassed, neutral, adore. event: love, idea, celebration, sleep, peace, disappear, appear, halloween, matrix, magic, robot. action: skip, juggle, dance, eat, work, guitar, sneeze, sixseven, basketball, drive, ride, kitten, wave. move: 'left', 'right', 'walk', 'jump', 'stand', 'idle', 'skateboard', 'parachute'. Informal words are fine (hearts, yay, poof, rope, sleepy) and underscores work instead of spaces (walk_left).
